text_block_list.text:
Invited by Sakura Laurel, I made my way to 
the riverbank. She said we'd be joining a 
sandlot baseball game between Umamusume 
teams, but—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Trainer, you came!
choice_data_list:
It's rare to see Laurel playing baseball, 
after all.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Ryan-chan invited me. Along with 
Kawakami-chan and Royce-chan. Look, over 
there—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
As expected of our pillar, Ryan-chan is 
having a huge impact both pitching and 
batting.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Royce is working hard as the director, 
putting her big brain to work, so—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Kawakami-chan is... hehe. She's super 
pumped, saying, "It's just like a baseball 
episode in PriFigh!"♪

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Unfortunately, I haven't been of much help 
just yet. So I figured I'd try my best to 
make up for it with vocal support and the 
like.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Hey Laurel, it's about time for your turn 
to bat—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer, you came. In that case, I 
gotta show you my best! Feel free to swing 
away with all you've got.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, thank you! I'll do my very best to 
contribute!

"The match progressed in such a fun yet 
heated atmosphere. However, as the game 
entered its final stages with Team Ryan in 
the lead, something unexpected happened—"

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
UWOOOOOH! Secret Technique: 'Purify 
Rainbow Swing'!

text_block_list.name: Referee
text_block_list.text: Strike! Batter out!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
M-My ultimate swing was... What kind of 
absurd pitch are you throwing, you 
bastard?!

text_block_list.name: Opposing Pitcher
text_block_list.text:
Heh, you can't hit my pitches on sheer 
willpower alone. I'll shut you out 
completely for the rest of the innings.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Such a blistering fastball unleashed from 
that gifted frame, like it could devour 
everything in its path...! I must update 
the data immediately!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Good grief, I had no idea they had a 
secret weapon like that. Even for me, 
hitting that pitch isn't going to be 
easy...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"I don't mind! You may have gotten the 
better of me this time, but I will 
definitely have my revenge next time!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, can't let ourselves lose confidence. 
We're still in the lead, so let's defend 
it with all we've got!

However, perhaps swallowed up by the 
immense presence of the opposing pitcher, 
the team's performance took a visible 
downturn—

text_block_list.name: Teammate A
text_block_list.text: Ah!

text_block_list.name: Teammate A
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, Ryan... It's my fault we got 
overtaken...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry about it, don't worry about 
it! If they take it from us, we'll just 
take it right back!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"Still, that's the hardest part, isn't it? 
That pitcher can't be an ordinary player, 
but no matter how much I look, I can't 
find any data on him..."

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
You must not give up! For one who can 
overcome any hardship and turn the 
tides—that is a true princess!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Kawakami-chan is right. Stay calm 
especially in times of hardship. If we 
don't give up and look for a way out, a 
path will surely open up.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
For example—with a pitcher that 
incredible, why didn't they bring him in 
until the latter half?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"...I get it! They probably can't throw 
for long innings. I don't think they're 
the type of pitcher with much stamina."

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
I see. In that case, from this at-bat 
onward, we need the batters to draw it out 
as long as possible and—
And then came the final episode.

text_block_list.name: Referee
text_block_list.text: "Batter, OUT!"

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Aaaagh! How frustrating! I was so close to 
knocking it out of the park!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
OK! You really hung in there, 
Kawakami-san. Just as Laurel-san said.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, their pitch velocity is visibly 
dropping. The strategy to wear them down 
worked like a charm.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
I've been cornered, but there's still a 
chance. If I can just connect the baton 
here...

Two outs, bases empty, down by one run. At 
the very least, she needs to get on base. 
Though she's still hitless today—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, I don't have Ryan-chan's baseball 
sense, nor Kawakami-chan's power. But—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"It's okay, I'll definitely get on base. 
I'll keep our chances alive so I can pass 
the torch to Ryan-chan...!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Ah! ...Laurel. Understood, I'll make sure 
my shoulders are fully warmed up.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
(Incredible... It has the intensity of a 
GⅠ Umamusume... But I can't lose. Not 
after everyone worked so hard to pass the 
baton to me—)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Without fail—I'll hit it!
(*CRACK!*)

text_block_list.name: Teammates
text_block_list.text: Yay! We did it! You did it!

The match ended in Team Ryan's victory. 
When Sakura Laurel made it to base with 
that spirited hit back then—

Next up, Mejiro Ryan hit a brilliant home 
run, bringing an end to the fierce battle.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much for staying and 
watching until the very end today.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, somehow I just knew. That with a 
swing carrying everyone's feelings, there 
was no way I'd miss――

Her gentle, humble smile was illuminated 
beautifully by the setting sun—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Ryan-chan was the one who delivered the 
final blow, you know? I just gave her a 
little nudge.

It's true that Mejiro Ryan delivered the 
decisive blow, but I believe it was Sakura 
Laurel's unrelenting will that paved the 
way there.
